subject: c10-eng

weightage.label: Writing Skills and Grammar (Ch 2 and 3): grammar 10 + writing 10
Language through Literature: First Flight and Footprints Without Feet (Ch 4 to 6)

note: Marks are official (theory total 80; internal assessment 20). Reading 20 = a discursive passage (10) and a case-based factual passage (10). Writing and Grammar 20 = grammar 10 (answer 10 of 12 gap-filling, editing or transformation questions) and writing 10 (formal letter 5, analytical paragraph 5). Literature 40 = extracts 5 + 5, First Flight short answers 12, Footprints short answers 6, First Flight long answers 6, Footprints long answer 6.
mistakes: Grammar: you attempt 10 out of 12 questions, so skip the two you are least sure of.
Reading short answers: keep them to 30 to 40 words, and answer from the passage.
Formal letter and analytical paragraph: stay within 100 to 120 words and follow the format. For the paragraph, use the data in the map, chart or cue given.
Literature short answers are 40 to 50 words, and long answers are about 100 to 120 words. Keep to the limit.
For extract questions, read the whole extract before answering, and answer from the lines given.
order: Literature first (Ch 4 to 6, 40 marks): read each prose piece, poem and story from both books and write short notes.
Then Reading (20 marks): practise one discursive and one case-based passage each week.
Then Writing and Grammar (20 marks): practise the formal letter and the analytical paragraph, and revise the grammar topics in the syllabus.
Keep internal assessment (20 marks) on schedule with your school.
